improved_gouge.name: Improved Gouge
improved_gouge.text: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 0.5 sec.

remorseless_attacks.name: Remorseless Attacks
remorseless_attacks.text: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

malice.name: Malice
malice.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

ruthlessness.name: Ruthlessness
ruthlessness.text: Gives your finishing moves a 20% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

murder.name: Murder
murder.text: Increases all damage dealt by 2% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

improved_slice_and_dice.name: Improved Slice and Dice
improved_slice_and_dice.text: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

relentless_strikes.name: Relentless Strikes
relentless_strikes.text: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

improved_expose_armor.name: Improved Expose Armor
improved_expose_armor.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Point when cast with 5 Combo Points.

lethality.name: Lethality
lethality.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.

vile_poisons.name: Vile Poisons
vile_poisons.text: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 4% and gives your poisons an additional 8% chance to resist dispel effects.

cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
cold_blood.text: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

improved_poisons.name: Improved Poisons
improved_poisons.text: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 2%, and gives Poison applications a 10% chance to not consume a charge.

mutilate.name: Mutilate
mutilate.text: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 13 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

improved_kidney_shot.name: Improved Kidney Shot
improved_kidney_shot.text: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 5% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

seal_fate.name: Seal Fate
seal_fate.text: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 20% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

venom.name: Venom
venom.text: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point: 9 seconds 2 points: 12 seconds 3 points: 15 seconds 4 points: 18 seconds 5 points: 21 seconds

improved_eviscerate.name: Improved Eviscerate
improved_eviscerate.text: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%.

improved_sinister_strike.name: Improved Sinister Strike
improved_sinister_strike.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 3.

puncturing_wounds.name: Puncturing Wounds
puncturing_wounds.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

precision.name: Precision
precision.text: Increases your chance to hit with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

improved_sprint.name: Improved Sprint
improved_sprint.text: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

improved_kick.name: Improved Kick
improved_kick.text: Gives your Kick ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

restless_blades.name: Restless Blades
restless_blades.text: Your damaging finishing moves reduce the remaining cooldown of your Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Evasion, Sprint, and Vanish abilities by 2 sec per combo point.

dual_wield_specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual_wield_specialization.text: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5%.

blade_flurry.name: Blade Flurry
blade_flurry.text: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

hack_and_slash.name: Hack and Slash
hack_and_slash.text: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor.

weapon_expertise.name: Weapon Expertise
weapon_expertise.text: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.

aggression.name: Aggression
aggression.text: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline_rush.text: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.text: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 3% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

master_of_deception.name: Master of Deception
master_of_deception.text: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 1 level higher.

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.text: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 5%.

setup.name: Setup
setup.text: Gives you a 33% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging an attack or fully resisting a spell.

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness
elusiveness.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 45 sec.

dirty_tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
dirty_tricks.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 25%.

improved_ambush.name: Improved Ambush
improved_ambush.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 15%.

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.text: Gives you a 33% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

ghostly_strike.name: Ghostly Strike
ghostly_strike.text: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

improved_distract.name: Improved Distract
improved_distract.text: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 3 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 1 level lower.

heightened_senses.name: Heightened Senses
heightened_senses.text: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 1 level higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%.

premeditation.name: Premeditation
premeditation.text: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

serrated_blades.name: Serrated Blades
serrated_blades.text: Causes your attacks to ignore 3% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 10%.

dirty_deeds.name: Dirty Deeds
dirty_deeds.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 10, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.text: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.text: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

quietus.name: Quietus
quietus.text: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 2% more damage against targets below 35% health.

cutthroat.name: Cutthroat
cutthroat.text: Your Backstab has a 3% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.text: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.
